title: Rename an exported function and update all importers (interface/implementation split)
prompt: In this mcpp C++23 modules project, module `hello.greet` (interface unit src/greet/greet.cppm, implementation unit src/greet/greet.cpp) exports a function `std::string greet(std::string_view who)`. Rename it to `salute`, keeping its signature and behavior unchanged, and update every importer that calls it (including src/main.cpp) so the project builds and its tests pass.
check: import pathlib,sys; text = (pathlib.Path('src/greet/greet.cppm').read_text() + pathlib.Path('src/greet/greet.cpp').read_text()); sys.exit(0 if ('salute' in text and 'greet(' not in text) else 1)
